== Reward ==

<ul><li>  A bronze weapon
</li><li> Coin (4-15 gold)
</li><li> [[Faction]]
</li></ul>

== Walkthrough ==

Chesgard Sydwen, in the house of thunder, is willing to reward those who help eliminate the bandits in the Karanas.  Bring him a [[Bandit Sash|Bandit Sash]] and he will give you xp (about one blue to a 12 bard), faction, some decent gold and a bronze weapon.

'''Upon handing in a sash:'''

: Chesgard Sydwen says, 'Good work Bard .  The Karana Bandits have been plaguing the Rainkeepers flock for some time.  Take this as a small reward for your devotion.  Continue the fight against the Karana Bandits.  Ahh... I wish [Cheslin] was equally as skilled.'

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction with [[Bloodsabers]] has gotten worse.
* Your faction with [[Guards of Qeynos]] has gotten better.
* Your faction with [[Priests of Life]] has gotten better.
* Your faction with [[Knights of Thunder]] has gotten better.
</div>
{{YouGainExperience}}

You can hand in more than one sash, you will get multiple rewards.

'''Note (5/25/2020)''': on P99Green, I did not get any [[Karana Residents]] faction hit, but did decrease [[Bloodsabers]].  Confirmed on 9/20/20 on Green.  Changed to reflect this. '''WARNING''' : Turning in too many bandit sashes will quickly turn you KOS for Worshippers of [[Bertoxxulous]] in the Qeynos Catacombs.
